plan.title: Psoriasis lesional vs control: limma DE + pathway activity
plan.analytical_narrative: Only a gene-level TPM table (12000 genes x 12 samples: 6 lesional, 6 control skin) was delivered, with no raw counts or Salmon quantification directories. This rules out count-based models (DESeq2/edgeR/voom), which require integer counts with NB variance — the knowledge base flags this explicitly (R-0004). The sound path is: (1) QC sample structure on log2(TPM+1) values via PCA/MDS to confirm lesional vs control separation and rule out a technical outlier before modelling; (2) filter genes below 1 TPM in fewer than 6 samples (the smaller group size, both groups being 6); (3) log2(TPM+1) is itself the only normalization appropriate for already-abundance-scaled data — no size-factor or TMM renormalization; (4) fit a limma linear model (lmFit/eBayes with trend=TRUE, robust=TRUE) on log2(TPM+1) with an explicit reference level (control) and named contrast (lesional-control), since limma-on-log-values is the only permitted DE method for abundance data per the knowledge check; (5) select DE genes by BH-adjusted p-value, not raw p or fold-change alone; (6) run over-representation analysis (not preranked GSEA, which the knowledge check rejected for this design) using an explicit universe of tested genes against MSigDB Hallmark first, then GO/canonical pathway collections staged in the reference store; (7) infer signalling pathway activity with decoupleR mlm on the PROGENy human footprint model as a mechanistic-context companion to the DE list; (8) compile a report with the full reproducibility record (session info, package versions, thresholds, n tested/n DE, gene set collection versions). All steps operate on this specific 12-sample, single-batch, unpaired design; no batch correction is needed since batch is reported as a single batch.

clusterProfiler / fgsea GSEA on full ranked gene list against MSigDB Hallmark, then Reactome/WikiPathways/GO
decoupleR mlm on PROGENy human footprint model, top 500 responsive genes
Structured DE + pathway report with reproducibility record

Structured DE + pathway report with reproducibility record
